details: This supplement completely defines and matches C3:570-572 D_q,H,gamma,G,normalizers and four fibre products, and C3:691-696 reconstruction/gluing. It adds the required finite quotient maps and source-indexed corrections. It does not substitute B.8.5 for the separate named-geometric comparison in B.16 or the restricted-conjugator objects in B.17-B.18. Those remain separate coverage contributions.

Universal matrix conjugation identities are symbolically verified; all finite D/gamma/G homomorphism pairs and every fibre-product image/kernel are enumerated. S4 distinguishes t from t-prime and the full loop group from L(D0); SL2(F3)→A4 refutes automatic normalizer surjectivity; C4/V4 tests the final gluing alternative. Exact unverified late comparisons are source-indexed in B.16/B.18, not described as a merely incomplete editorial audit.

The functorial kernel formulas and corrected coefficient-subgroup exact sequences are proved in profinite groups, and their finite constant group-scheme cases are exact fppf sequences overZ. The different restriction of the conjugating subgroup is B.17-B.18; it is not silently identified with this D0 variant.

Congruence-kernel stability for every effective signed automorphism is now proved, with explicit matrix conjugator and exact K_gamma=A_q, K_G=N semidirect A_q. S4→S3 supplies full finite images/kernels and SL2(F3)→A4 a genuine conjugator-lifting obstruction. The remaining exact congruence assertion is to determine H_q and A_q; (B.15.16) fixes an explicit target multiplier mu_5=2,mu_p=1 elsewhere and asks for its compatible full profinite lift. Its individual target conjugacy conditions are proved and checked modulo5. No claim of literature-openness or a least unit is made. B.8.5, the named image B.16 and restricted comparison B.18 remain distinct.
